<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Find a subrange corresponding to the lane mask <span class="doxyComputerOutput">LM</span>, or a superset of it, in the live interval <span class="doxyComputerOutput">LI</span>.</p>


<p>The interval <span class="doxyComputerOutput">LI</span> is assumed to contain such a subrange. This function is used to find corresponding subranges between the original interval and the new intervals.</p>


<p>Definition at line 421 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/splitkit-cpp">SplitKit.cpp</a>.</p>
